t: The library opens at eight on weekdays.
Please return borrowed books to the front desk.
Group study rooms can be reserved online in advance.
Students may print up to fifty pages each week for free.
The quiet floor is reserved for individual study at all times.
If you need help finding sources, ask a librarian at the reference desk on the second floor.
Laptops can be borrowed for up to four hours, but they must be returned before the library closes.
